Hero.subtitle: We don’t build websites. We engineer cinematic digital architecture for brands whose reputation is the product: experiences that stay smooth, load fast and are measured, not promised.

Architecture.label: 01 — Architecture
Architecture.title: Engineering, not decoration.
Architecture.intro: Every pixel is a decision, every frame a promise. The three columns explain why a site built here feels precise, not just fast.
Architecture.c1Title: Video, not code. Cinema, in the browser.
Architecture.c1Text: We left heavy render engines and stuttering animation layers behind. Your hero and showcase streams are served as native MP4/WebM video, decoded by the device’s own video hardware, so the stream costs the processor little.
Architecture.c1Tags: H.264 · VP9 · Loads on demand · Space reserved, no layout shift
Architecture.c1VideoLabel: A glass monolith turning slowly on a black background
Architecture.c2Text: Scrolling and transitions follow the display’s own frame rhythm. On desktops with a mouse or trackpad, Lenis eases the scroll; touch devices keep their native, immediate scroll. The page moves like an extension of your finger, not under it.
Architecture.c2Tags: Lenis smooth scroll · requestAnimationFrame · GPU-composited transforms
Architecture.c2Caption: Measured while scrolling on a 60 Hz display. {profile}. {date}.
Architecture.c2GraphAlt: A line chart of frame time, flat at the 60 Hz frame interval
Architecture.c3Title: Beauty becomes luxury when it can be measured.
Architecture.c3Text: Performance, accessibility, best practices, SEO: four rings, measured on this very page. A high-budget visitor who leaves in three seconds is never won back by a manifesto, so we measure first and say it afterwards.
Architecture.c3Tags: CLS · LCP · TBT · measured, dated and sourced
Architecture.c3Detail: Desktop: CLS {cls}, LCP {lcp}, TBT {tbt}. Mobile (simulated slow 4G, 4× CPU slowdown): performance {mobile}.

Showcase.label: 02 — Showcase
Showcase.title:
Three industries.
One standard of silence.
Showcase.subtitle: Quiet, restrained, trustworthy. Each industry speaks its own language; the standard is the same.

estate.title: Not a property. A stage for living.
estate.text: A penthouse with a view of the Bosphorus is not bought from a screen; it is felt. Cinematic entry sequences, interactive daylight simulation on floor plans, and an enquiry flow that lands directly with your sales team.
estate.videoLabel: A glass-fronted villa at dusk, the camera moving slowly in

clinic.title: Trust is built in the first second.
clinic.text: For aesthetic surgery, dental or longevity clinics: a calm, sterile, premium digital reception. Physician profiles and an appointment flow guide your patient without frightening them.
clinic.videoLabel: A pale clinic corridor in slow motion, soft light moving along the ceiling

law.title: Discretion is the first thing a client reads.
law.text: For law firms and advisory practices: a restrained, precise digital presence. Practice-area and partner pages, a confidential enquiry flow, and a structure in which every word is yours to approve, because applying the advertising rules for lawyers is your responsibility.
law.videoLabel: A dark colonnade receding towards a lit doorway, the camera moving slowly forward

Legal.privacyIntro: This notice explains which personal data this website processes and why.
Legal.p2: If you send a briefing, we process your answers (project type, investment range, timing), your name, company and title, work email, your role in the decision, an optional one-sentence description and the language of the page, to reply to your request. The briefing is delivered to our team through [DELIVERY SERVICE: signed webhook, n8n, Gmail]. Legal basis: taking steps at your request, your consent (the unticked box you confirm before sending) and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.
Legal.p3: Our hosting provider processes technical request data, including your IP address, to deliver and protect the site. We use your IP address only for short-lived rate limiting that blocks abusive traffic. When you reach the last step of the briefing, a bot check by Cloudflare Turnstile runs and processes technical data such as your IP address.
Legal.p4: We do not set cookies of our own. Your language is chosen by the address of the page (“/” for English, “/tr” for Turkish and so on) and is not stored. We use no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.
Legal.p5: Cloudflare (Turnstile bot check), n8n and Google (Gmail) process data on our behalf to deliver your briefing; some of their servers are outside your country. [TRANSFER SAFEGUARDS, e.g. standard contractual clauses]. Their own privacy policies apply to what they process.
Legal.p6: We keep briefings for [RETENTION PERIOD] unless a contract is concluded, in which case statutory retention periods apply.
Legal.p7: Under applicable data-protection law (for example GDPR or KVKK) you can request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, object to processing, withdraw your consent and complain to your supervisory authority. Contact us at contact@syncflow.agency.
